text:
incident-bot: Incident detected - increased 95th latency on /v1/generate in us-west-2, spike started ~12:04 UTC. 5xx rate low, latency up. Alert ID INC-2026-342
emma: seeing it on grafana too. p95 jumped from 120ms -> ~900ms. Affected both hosted and dedicated. Customers on heavy throughput flows complaining.
sanjay: Affected models: gpt-large-v1 (quantized). Continuous batching queue depth spiking. Logs show batch sizes hitting 2048 tokens, causing KV cache thrash.
li: @sanjay can you share the tail logs? suspect batching window got increased by rollout earlier.
sanjay: past deploy at 11:50 bumped `batching.default_window_ms` from 20 -> 60 on canary, rolled to 100% at 11:59. rolling back now.
rebecca: paging in oncall for next 30. I'll take lead for mitigation unless you object.
emma: ack. I'll coordinate customer comms & upstream routing.
sanjay: rolling-back config: `infractl route-config set batching.default_window_ms=20 --env=prod --selector=us-west-2` (running)
ops-bot: Command executed by sanjay: infractl route-config set batching.default_window_ms=20 --status=queued
sanjay: applied, pushing to runtime controllers... please hold traffic shaping while it propagates.
li: checking pod-level metrics. queue depth dropping on inference-nodes-12 now. latency p95 falling to ~300ms.
rebecca: we should also throttle burst traffic from heavy tenants for next 10min while rollout settles. Suggest temporary rate-limit: `tenant-rate: 500 rps` for tenants with key prefix `enterprise-`.
emma: added a quota-change ticket and will apply via admin-console. admin-console change: setQuota(enterprise-*, rps=500) -> rolling.
ops-bot: Quota update applied to 8 tenants: enterprise-alpha, enterprise-beta, enterprise-gamma... status: success
sanjay: can we also temporarily disable KV prefetch for quantized paths? That reduced mem churn in earlier incidents.
li: toggled `runtime.kv_prefetch=false` on canary nodes. Observing memory stability but slight CPU uptick.
rebecca: alerting support to expect customer tickets about slightly higher latency for burst traffic. drafting note: "We're mitigating a latency regression caused by batching parameter change; temporary throughput caps applied; full performance restored expected within 15 min."
emma: customer-facing message ready. sending to top-20 affected customers now.
sanjay: p95 stabilized around 140-180ms for majority, a few cold-nodes at 260ms. No 5xx spike.
li: runtime traces show fewer massive batches; avg batch size down from 120 -> 35 tokens.
rebecca: handing off to night oncall in 20m. @emma you'll escalate if SLA errors appear.
emma: will monitor dashboards and error budgets. leaving pointers: if p95>300ms or 5xx>0.1% revert `batching.default_window_ms` to 10 and re-open rate limits.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 severity downgraded to S2 at 12:25 UTC. Root cause: accidental parameter change during canary rollout (batch window too large for quantized gpt-large-v1 leading to KV cache thrash).
sanjay: filed PR to gate batch-window changes behind perf-tests + canary size limiter: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pull/4521
rebecca: creating postmortem stub and will attach logs/traces. assigning action items: automation to block >40ms change without metric guard, run perf-harness on quantized builds, and customer-notifications template.
li: snapshotting telemetry for the two affected clusters and saving to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-2026-342/
emma: thanks all. night oncall @maria you taking? (cc @maria)
maria: taking it. will watch for next 3 hours. ping me in thread for any escalations.
rebecca: closing coordination loop. If anything regresses reopen. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 marked resolved by rebecca at 12:38 UTC. Postmortem pending.
